message:
Dear Customer,

The value of the collateral pledged against your {% if doc.loan %}loan {{ doc.loan }}{% else %}loans{% endif %} has fallen. You owe {{ doc.get_formatted("loan_amount") }} against collateral now worth {{ doc.get_formatted("security_value") }}.

{% if doc.status == "Sale Triggered" %}

The fall is large enough that the lender will now sell part of the collateral to bring the loan back within its limit.

{% else %}

To restore the margin, repay {{ doc.get_formatted("shortfall_amount") }} or pledge more collateral by {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.cure_by) }}. If the margin is not restored by then, the lender may sell the collateral.

{% endif %}

Thank you.
name: Margin Call Notice
subject: Margin call on your {% if doc.loan %}loan {{ doc.loan }}{% else %}loans{% endif %}
